entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon assassin of the Ochran and planeswalker who accepts Bolas's contract to find Orazca and captains the ship The Belligerent.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: A golden elder dragon who hires Vraska by promising to make her Guildmaster of the Golgari in exchange for retrieving an item from Orazca.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker, here stranded and amnesiac, whom Vraska rescues and recruits for her crew.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: The siren navigator of The Belligerent and a lifelong member of the Brazen Coalition.

entities.name: Amelia
entities.description: The tall helmsmage and quartermaster of The Belligerent.

entities.name: Edgar
entities.description: The ship's other helmsmage.

entities.name: Gavven
entities.description: The dour coxswain of The Belligerent.

entities.name: Mazirek
entities.description: The kraul death priest whom Vraska recalls when Bolas offers to make her guildmaster.

entities.name: Jarad vod Savo
entities.description: The malignant Golgari guildmaster whom Vraska wishes to replace.

entities.name: The Legion of Dusk Captain
entities.description: A golden-armored vampire captain who fights Vraska and is petrified into a figurehead.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: A saint invoked by the vampires in prayer.

entities.name: The Belligerent
entities.description: The great schooner that Vraska captains with a Brazen Coalition crew.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: A magical compass given by Bolas to lead Vraska to the Golden City.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact stolen from the vampires' monasteries, which they seek to end their vampirism.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: A legendary city on Ixalan where an item awaits retrieval.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A pirate alliance of humans, ogres and goblins to which Vraska's crew belongs.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampire conquistadors who invaded Ixalan and who attack the Brazen Coalition.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that Vraska hopes to lead.

entities.name: Ochran
entities.description: The assassins' group on Ravnica to which Vraska belongs.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: A faraway artificial plane of shallow water and floating hills where Bolas meets Vraska.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where the Golden City of Orazca lies and where Vraska sails.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Vraska's home plane.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: A harbor where the crew plans to make landfall.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The ancestral lands that the vampires took.

events.summary: Vraska finds an enchanted invitation from a dragon in her book and planeswalks to the Meditation Plane.
events.quote: she planeswalked through a dark slice in the air.

events.summary: Nicol Bolas hires Vraska, reading her mind and offering to make her Guildmaster of the Golgari.
events.quote: I can make you Guildmaster of the Golgari, Vraska.

events.summary: Bolas tasks Vraska with retrieving an item from the Golden City of Orazca on Ixalan, to be summoned by an associate.
events.quote: Retrieve the item that is there, summon my associate to transport it

events.summary: Vraska accepts, and Bolas bars her from double-crossing him.
Bolas gives Vraska the thaumatic compass and implants a spell to call his associate and knowledge of sailing.
Months later Vraska captains The Belligerent, and the compass directs her crew south.
The crew spots a castaway on a seastack and Vraska recognizes Jace Beleren, resolving to petrify him.
Vraska sees Jace is emaciated and ill, drops her petrifying gaze and asks what happened to him.
events.quote: Vraska snuffed the fire in her mind and looked down at him with no magic in her eyes.

events.summary: Jace tells Vraska he does not remember anything before waking on an island, and she concludes it is not an illusion.
events.quote: I don't remember anything from before I woke up on the first island.

events.summary: Vraska decides not to kill the harmless Jace and tells him he can stay until the next harbor.
events.quote: We'll prepare a hammock for you in the forecastle,

events.summary: Jace accidentally touches Vraska, who flinches because she has not been touched in years.
events.quote: She had not physically touched anyone in years.

events.summary: A Legion of Dusk ship appears and Vraska recalls an earlier attack and the vampires' pursuit of the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: The Immortal Sun was stolen from their monasteries

events.summary: Vraska orders an attack; Jace camouflages the ship and she silences it with an assassin's spell as they approach.
events.quote: The Belligerent was now imperceptible to any outside its rails.

events.summary: The crew boards the vampire ship and takes it by surprise.
events.quote: The vampires were caught completely off guard.

events.summary: Vraska fights the vampire captain with Jace's illusion clones and petrifies him when he grabs Jace.
events.quote: The vampire's skin and clothes turned to stone in her grip.

events.summary: Jace is amazed rather than afraid at Vraska's gorgon power and thanks her, calling her talented.
events.quote: Jace was not afraid. He was amazed.

events.summary: Vraska invites Jace to stay with her crew, and he accepts.
